trust_surface_resolutions.description: Requiring persisted exact one-shot approvals in authorize_action changes the current authorization accept condition.
trust_surface_resolutions.resolution: Implemented 2026-08-22: authorize_action loads the persisted approval for the exact action digest, the SPARK-proved Approvals.Consume_Approval accepts it exactly once, the consumed record is made durable (F_FULLFSYNC + atomic rename) before the Action_Authorized event commits, and every failure path refuses (no_approval, approval_corrupt, approval_replayed, approval_revoked, approval_expired, mission/action mismatch). Approvals are issued only through the create_approval protocol command in the PLANNING state and can never be re-armed (Persist_Approval refuses overwrite).

trust_surface_resolutions.description: Replacing the synthesized capability grant with persisted parent and attenuated child grants changes capability issuance and replay semantics.
trust_surface_resolutions.resolution: Implemented 2026-08-22: the per-request synthesized grant is gone. A single immutable parent grant per mission is issued through the create_grant protocol command in the PLANNING state (all authority fields derived from the authorized mission context; the protocol cannot widen them) and persisted durably. authorize_action loads it and derives the per-action child through the SPARK-proved Capabilities.Derive_Child_Grant, whose postcondition guarantees Is_Attenuation (Parent, Child); a runtime Is_Attenuation re-check remains as defense in depth. Missing, corrupt, or inactive parents refuse (no_parent_grant, grant_corrupt, parent_grant_inactive).
